extraits.texte: Yasmin’s preaching sessions feel like an interactive seminar from a vibrant professor. She touches on the fundamentals _everything has a resonating effect on me. Kudos to you and your team! May Allah reward your efforts.
I love listening to her lectures..but unfortunately the podcasts aren't the best quality. Lots of static. Lots of background noise. Hard to hear her at times. I have to blast the volume to hear her.
Usthada Yasmin has inspired many and will continue to do so. MashaAllah, she is truly a unique speaker. May Allah increase her in barakah for her efforts.
